usedFor: Shopify takes your orders, and Fireberry stores each “New Order” as a record through “Create Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Record” in Fireberry
bestTemplate.why: Every order lands in Fireberry as a record, so the team working there sees sales without opening the store.

watchOut: “New Order” and “Order Paid” both fire for one sale, so connect one of them to avoid duplicate records.
